issues.problem: A pre-set SB_INSTALL_RUN_START is trusted unvalidated. A stale value keeps a backup from an earlier run, and the pre-run original is never saved. A non-numeric or future value falls back to per-process start or always refreshes, so the backup becomes the intermediate file, which is the r4 symptom. The installers share the same pattern, so this is not a regression of this delta. Separately, because the lib is sourced, the export persists in post-release-host-verify.sh after the codex uninstall, and the later install-codex.sh, the RC smoke and the claude host inherit it. The effect is benign: the backups keep the pre-verify original.

issues.suggested_fix: Optional hardening in _backup_is_from_this_run: ignore a start that is non-numeric, in the future, or older than some bound (e.g. 1 day), and fall back to the process start. Not required for merge.
